author: Yffe
content: Cluster 3 of the primitive-completeness buildout: break/continue in loops. Plan: (1) lexer TokKind::Break/Continue + keyword_kind arms; (2) ast Stmt::Break/Continue payload-less variants; (3) parser parse_break_continue + loop_depth counter with SyntaxError::BreakContinueOutsideLoop (in-loop structural rule); (4) lowering lower_stmt/lower_stmt_l1 emit Verus-native break;/continue; (l2 routes through l1, no obligation suppression); (5) close the Stmt match-arm ripple across address/effects/validator/mutation/vacuity/closure/review/check + skill prose with the layer-neutral leaf value (no _/panic); (6) grounded conformance probes in forge/tests/break_continue_conformance.rs against real verus: continue+inv/dec L3, bad continue L0 (inv + dec back-edge), break L3, fx-diverge break+continue L1 (#88 cap), break-outside-loop structured error, sum/binary_search no regression. REQ statuses to SHIPPED across the 4 syntax/lower docs.
